Identify, develop activities, and deliver safety improvement programs aimed to rectify any safety deficiencies within the region collaborating with governments, airlines, ANSPs and airports utilizing regional aviation safety forums. This may include the development of country specific safety strategies. Contribute to the commercial strategy and targets assigned to the region by promoting IATA products and services.
